integrity: The general combinatorial proof and the exact length-counting argument are included, alongside bounded independently implemented enumeration. No independence or external certification is claimed.
limitations: Distinct nonempty palindromic scattered subsequence values of repeated fixed permutations only, not counts of embeddings or extremal counts among arbitrary words.
Alphabet has at least three distinct symbols; arbitrary concatenations of different permutations are not covered.
Finite checks corroborate but are not the proof for unbounded parameters; equivalence in unindexed literature remains a risk.
title: Palindromic subsequence spectra of repeated alphabet permutations
